audit.whatIsWrong: The cage is attributed to the wrong slot everywhere in the content layer: 'his E (Dark Procession) wall', 'E cage', 'E mist-cage', 'trap-cage'. Dark Procession is Yorick's W. His E is Mourning Mist, a thrown globule that reduces armour, slows and marks you.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range) summons a destructible wall that blocks movement — destructible is the key word, you can break out rather than wait. Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range) marks the target, and summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets, which is what actually pulls the ghoul swarm onto you.
audit.corrected: Cage renamed to Dark Procession (W) with its 20s rank-1 cooldown and destructibility; Mourning Mist named as the armour-shred mark that calls the ghouls in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick while the packet chart is Skill, Maokai x5, Yorick and whys[1] through whys[5] each describe Maokai owning that stage.
audit.why: Yorick is immobile with no answer to a point-and-click root before Maiden, and Sapling Toss clears the ghouls that are his only early pressure. He genuinely owns only the 2+ item split, which matches a 54.08% win rate.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 through First item to Maokai, 2+ items stays Yorick and drops to 3/10.

audit.why: Spikes are honest, including the unusual and correct admission that Level 6 is only a modest spike for Maokai here — Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1, so his ult is the real event, and Nature's Grasp mostly buys a jungle dive.

edits.before: This is where it flips. Yorick is a hard scaler, and once he has 2+ items with Maiden plus a full ghoul swarm and his E cage, he zones me off the wave and out-splits me in the side lane — my damage doesn't scale, so I can't punch through that the way I bullied him early. Don't try to 1v1 a fed splitpushing Yorick into his trap-cage; that's his game, not mine. My value late is exactly what his isn't: I group, W-root and R-wall his Maiden-backed engage in 5v5s, and let the lead I built in the 2-5 window decide the map before his splitpush takes over.

notes: The cage was attributed to Yorick's E in five places; it is his W, Dark Procession, and it is destructible — worth knowing because 'wait out the cage' and 'break the cage' are different plays. Mourning Mist's mark pulling summoned units toward you is straight from Riot's text and was not on the page at all; it is now the reason given for dodging the globule.
